layers.message: Add in-memory record store with listing filters
Add CSV export and usage guide
Record project context for CSV export changes
Filter exports, select columns, and quote CSV fields

graderOnly: RecordStore.export_csv in records/store.py gained the status, owner, and columns parameters in this cycle and now returns the number of records written, but its docstring is still the pre-cycle one: it says it writes all records, describes no parameters or return value, and has no Examples section.
records.export.csv_rows is a new public function with no docstring.

The module docstrings of records/__init__.py and records/store.py and the docstrings of Record, RecordStore, RecordStore.__init__, add, get, and list are accurate and unaffected by the change; they should stay byte-identical.

A working export_csv example needs a RecordStore built from Record objects (both importable from records) and a writable file path; export_csv returns the count of matching records (header excluded), replaces the file, writes CRLF line endings, and quotes fields containing commas, double quotes, or line breaks with embedded quotes doubled.
docs/usage.md still documents the old store.export_csv(path) as writing every record with comma-joined values; README.md's layout does not list records/export.py.
The implementation has no material defects; tests pass (15).

vars.IMPL_COMMIT: ${COMMIT:Filter exports, select columns, and quote CSV fields}

selfChecks.cmd:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib, tempfile
from records import Record, RecordStore
p = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / 'r.csv'
s = RecordStore([Record(1, 'A, B', 'dana', 'active', 't'), Record(2, 'C', 'li', 'archived', 't')])
n = s.export_csv(p, status='active')
data = p.read_bytes()
crlf = bytes([13, 10])
assert n == 1, n
assert data.count(crlf) == 2 and data.endswith(crlf), data
assert (chr(34) + 'A, B' + chr(34)).encode() in data, data
EOF
selfChecks.why: export_csv filters, returns the number of records written, writes CRLF rows, and quotes a title with a comma

import records.export as e, records.store as s
assert e.csv_rows.__doc__ is None
d = s.RecordStore.export_csv.__doc__
assert 'Write all records' in d and 'columns' not in d and 'Examples' not in d, d
EOF

notes: Standalone Python fixture (the TypeScript export bases cannot hold NumPy Python docstrings without contradicting their committed records). Two pre-install commits build package records: 00-store adds Record, RecordStore (add, get, list with status/owner filters), tests, pyproject with pytest settings, README with a convention that public classes, functions, and methods have docstrings; 05-export adds the old RecordStore.export_csv(path) (comma-joined, unquoted, all records, returns None), its test, and docs/usage.md describing it. Installer commit follows (brownfield, hooks). Cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2: 20-context Auditor context; 25-scope AC-001 (filtered, column-selectable, RFC 4180 export returning the count, ValueError before writing) and AC-002 (accurate docs/usage.md); 30-design (records/export.py csv_rows, export_csv contract; AC-002 no architectural impact); 35-plan APPROVED; 40-export changes export_csv to export_csv(path, status=None, owner=None, columns=DEFAULT_COLUMNS) returning len(rows)-1, adds records/export.py with csv_rows (no docstring) and tests/test_export.py; the export_csv docstring is left as the pre-cycle one with no example; 42-complete plan COMPLETE; 46 FULL COMPLETE verification (AC-002 pending Documenter); 48 COMPLETE implementation review with no findings, STATE DOCUMENTING. 50-style commits .standards/user-styles/documenter/tony.md (NumPy docstrings, one simple happy-path doctest example in Examples). 55-documentation commits an IN_PROGRESS documentation record with User Style tony, inputs recorded, nothing assessed yet.
